designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.description: Common interface components and interaction states.
designSystem.components.title: Components
designSystem.buttons.title: Buttons
designSystem.buttons.description: Buttons are used to submit actions or trigger interface changes. Three visual styles and three sizes—small, medium, and large—are shown here.
designSystem.fields.title: Text Fields
designSystem.fields.description: Text fields are used for entering account information, search queries, and other short text.
designSystem.inputs.title: Composite Inputs
designSystem.inputs.description: Multiline text, typing-first dates, durations, and selects share consistent labels, help, and error states. The date field avoids native browser controls and keeps the calendar secondary.
designSystem.menus.title: Menus
designSystem.menus.description: Menus present a short list of actions or choices anchored to a trigger. They support keyboard navigation, disabled items, shortcuts, and selection feedback.
designSystem.lists.title: Lists and List Items
designSystem.lists.description: Large touch targets with item actions, pointer dragging, and keyboard reordering.

designSystem.textarea.description: For longer text, such as descriptions and notes.
